message:
Let me build the fuzzer to test locally. First, let me check if there's a pre-built binary or if I need to build it:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "fuzzer" -o -name "*.a" 2>/dev/null | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
